text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur gets injured during training,
so I hastily
escort her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For the love of... Ugh. It looks like
regular
training's out of the question
today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to adjust my program. I've just
gotta
narrow down the scope as much as
possible...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're continuing training. Doing
nothing
isn't zero—it's of negative value.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'm sorry, is even regular
conversation too
difficult for you?
choice_data_list: さすがに今日は休もう
一緒にできることを探そう

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: もしもが起きたらマイナスどころじゃないよ

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna collate data. You're not
gonna
stop me from typing too, are you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna send you a list of things I
need. Go get
them for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur says this irritably and starts
hammering
at her keyboard.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna do some light exercise to
keep my
muscles from atrophying. I
don't need your
support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Air Shakur begins a gym
workout.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Change of plans. My body says to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur cuts her training session
short, looking
as if the pain has
resurfaced.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whew... It looks like I can do this much
at least.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's stay at this pace for now. And keep
any
extraneous opinions to yourself, got
it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur keeps her training light and
takes care
not to aggravate her injury.
